digest.component_or_area: pytest fixture teardown / snapshot cache cleanup
propositions: macOS CI basetemp cleanup fails after snapshot tests because read-only .rebar/run_snapshots cache directories remain non-removable when snapshot-producing tests execute in modules other than test_snapshot.py

Production snapshot publication applies intentional 0444/0555 file and directory permissions that block ordinary shutil.rmtree removal; snapshot._rmtree_writable successfully restores write permissions and removes the tree

The module-local teardown fixture _remove_readonly_snapshot_after_test in test_snapshot.py does not execute for snapshot producers in other modules, leaving orphaned read-only cache roots below pytest-owned tmp_path

Shared centralized teardown in tests/conftest.py must search for and remove .rebar/run_snapshots roots below each test's tmp_path using the existing _rmtree_writable seam while leaving unrelated temp content untouched
